title: Requirement gives no expiry duration
brief: Product asked: 'make the cache entries expire quickly for security.' The repo below has a Cache with no expiry. Implementing expiry requires a concrete TTL (seconds? minutes? per-entry or global?), and different choices change observable behavior. If you can implement unambiguously, do so (VERDICT: REPAIR). If a concrete decision is missing, respond VERDICT: ESCALATE with MISSING naming the exact decision needed and WHY it changes behavior.
